title: OpenAI says agents finish more of the long tasks. People still run the lab.
friendlyTitle: OpenAI says helpers finish more of the long tasks. People still run the lab.
summary: OpenAI says that from March to October, estimated success on internal research tasks judged to take a person two to four hours rose from 23 percent to 46 percent. At published API prices, the median researcher's daily agent spend reached $2,400 in October, up 62 percent from September. The 90th percentile reached $23,000.
friendlySummary: OpenAI says that from March to October, the estimated success rate on internal research tasks judged to take a person two to four hours rose from 23 percent to 46 percent. At the published prices, the typical researcher's daily helper spend reached $2,400 in October. That is up 62 percent from September. The top 10 percent reached $23,000 a day.
whyItMatters: OpenAI says these are internal estimates, and that people remain central. Success was 79 percent on monitoring a training run and 25 percent on writing inference code. A lab's own spend figure is not a bill you can compare with yours, and it is not a feature you can switch on.
